summary: Wellchange Holdings reported shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting for a 1-for-5 consolidation of Class A ordinary shares, with fractional shares rounded up. The Class B shares remain unconsolidated, and conversion rights adjust per the articles. The company also adopted a sixth amended memorandum and articles of association. The consolidation aims to reduce share count and potentially lift per-share price. Watch for Nasdaq compliance implications and any future reverse-split or listing actions.
